[ S. prādurbhāva], 1. the becoming visible; manifestation; appearance; D I 220, 34 (brahmuno etaṃ pubbenimittaṃ ~āya yad idaṃ āloko sañjāyati obhāso pātubhavatī ti); II 107, 11 (ko paccayo mahato bhūmicalassa ~āyā ti); 305, 8 (yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ … jāti sañjāti … khandhānaṃ ~o āyatanānaṃ paṭilābho ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave jāti); S III 228, 25 (cakkhussa uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti ~o); V 99, 2 foll. (rañño bhikkhave cakkavattissa ~ā sattannaṃ ratanānaṃ ~o hoti); A I 22, 8 (ekapuggalassa bhikkhave ~o dullabho lokasmiṃ); Sn 560 (yesaṃ vo dullabho ~o abhiṇhaso); Vism 416, 15 (tatiyo suriyo pātubhavati yassa ~ā mahānadiyo pi sussanti); Spk III 153, 9 foll.; 293, 15 (cattāri saccāni tathāgatass’ eva ~ā pākatāni honti); Sadd 71, 21 (pātubhavanaṃ ~o); 485, 23 (janī ~e); — 2. making appear; Spk III 153, 25 foll. (na kevalaṃ hi pātubhūtam eva ~o, pātubhāvayatī ti ~o); — apātubhāva , m. , non-appearance; absence; S IV 78, 12 (dhammānaṃ ~ā pamādavihārī tv eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati); Vism 156, 3 (vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ti … dutiyajjhānakkhaṇe ~ā ti vuttaṃ hoti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr aṅgapātubhāvā) = Nidd-a I 134, 18 ; Mp II 234, 13 (navanavānaṃ devaputtānaṃ ~ena devakāyā parihāyissanti); Vv-a 193, 31 (aṭṭha akkhaṇā nāma tayo apāyā … ~o buddhassā ti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee omits ).
